title: Catalyzed hydrothermal carbonization of sewage sludge: structural modification of hydrochar and its derived selective pyrolytic product distribution

Catalyzed (zeolites) HTC conversion of SS was investigated. Temperature-dependent pyrolysis of catalyzed HC facilitated selective syngas yield. Integrated HTC-Py promoted hazardous waste into valuable chemical precursors.
